name: Indian Scout (2015-on)
engine: 999 or 1133 cc liquid-cooled V-twin, fuel injected, belt drive
intro: Indian's liquid-cooled Scout. Several brake and fuel pump recalls across the years.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2015 bikes are in recall 15V142 (rear brake master cylinder). 2017-2018 bikes are in recall 18V416 (air in the ABS). 2015-2019 bikes with an accessory brake lever may be in recall 19E007. 2021-2022 bikes are in recall 22V837 (fuel pump). 2025 bikes are in recall 24V970 (false neutral on the display).
A-002.reason: Brake and fuel pump faults are crash risks. Every fix is free.

recalls.what: Rear brake master cylinder problem can reduce or remove rear braking.
recalls.fix: Dealer inspects and replaces the rear master cylinder free.

recalls.what: Air may be left in the ABS after assembly, reducing braking.
Accessory brake lever adjuster set wrong can make the front brake drag.
Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine.
Display may show neutral when the bike is in gear.
